observations.text: In the relevant photooxidation experiment starting from the cis methyl substrate, a substantial amount of the trans substrate configuration was observed after the reaction. This task only asks for an explanation of how local ring opening/closure is compatible with this observation; the complete photoreaction is not required.

stereochemistry: Only the relative cis/trans relationship between the N attachment and the adjacent Me/Ph group on cyclopropane is specified. Structures bearing @ select one enantiomeric representative; the complete mirror image is equally valid.
